# commons-phpmodels

> Typed decode of declarative PHP models — taint effects, value semantics, and declaration signatures — from YAML.

Kotlin/JVM library, package `edu.jhu.cobra.commons.phpmodels`, Gradle coordinate `com.github.jhu-seclab-cobra:commons-phpmodels`. Three loader objects decode YAML documents into immutable typed entries; every format violation raises `IllegalArgumentException` at load. Consumers own document location, layer ordering, and every query over the decoded entries.

## Instructions for Agents

- Call `ModelLoader.load(input)` to decode a model document into `List<ModelEntry>`.
- Call `VocabularyLoader.load(input)` before `PolicyLoader.load(input, vocabulary)` — the policy validates against the vocabulary.
- Catch `IllegalArgumentException` at the load boundary; it covers every decode failure, including `VocabularyException`.
- Intern color and category strings of decoded model entries through `Vocabulary.requireProvenance` / `Vocabulary.requireVulnClass` — `ModelLoader` does not.
- Never write `returns:` beside a callable `signature:` in a model file — load failure.
- Never hand-build subject instances from split strings — pass the PHP-native spelling to the subtype creator.

## Loading

- [Loaders](llms/loaders.md): The three loader objects, their inputs, and decode strictness.

- [Entries and Bodies](llms/entries.md): `ModelEntry`, `SubjectModel`, `ModelGenerator`, `ModelBody`, guards, ports, propagation.
- [Subjects and Signatures](llms/subjects.md): The seven subject kinds, spellings, case folding, `SignatureInfo` subtypes, `DeclaredType`.
- [Vocabulary and Policy](llms/vocabulary.md): `Vocabulary`, interned identifiers, `TaintPolicy`.
